description: LinkedIn company enrichment API for AI agents: send up to 10 LinkedIn company page URLs and get one JSON record per company: name, website, employee and follower counts, founding year, tagline, description, industries, specialities, headquarters and locations, company type. Pay per company in stablecoins; a company that is not found is not charged.

companies.description: LinkedIn company page URLs, 1 to 10, e.g. https://www.linkedin.com/company/stripe/ (https only, no query string); the call is priced per company

title: LinkedIn company enrichment
